title: Noor and the Mixtape
author: Lior Whitlock
blurb: Ulyana Eastwick, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
